$comment: What fills the rest of a frame of `ratio` (width over height) that shows a `w` by `h` photo whole, centred: each strip left over is (1 - min(r, ratio) / max(r, ratio)) / 2 of the frame's side it runs along the edge of (its height for strips top and bottom, its width for strips left and right), r being w / h. Under `strip`, the frame's mat (the ground colour); `strip` or wider, the same photo blurred (18 pt in the app, the site's 18 px) behind it. One rule for every whole frame: the site's tiles (apps/site/src/lib/img.ts wholeGround, tileFrame) and the app's head, tiles, list pictures and cards wherever its frames rule (protocols/photo-crop-vectors.json) shows a photo whole, as it does a photo sent with its whole area as its box (the Design Lead's frames.md, the chief of staff, 13 Nov). Generated by apps/site/test/whole-frame-vectors.test.ts: edit a case's inputs (note, w, h, ratio), then run UPDATE_VECTORS=1 on that test file.
